answer: Cloned glaziers tried to monopolize night kiln bookings at the south annex. To claim a slot, a worker must carry a 310 g lotus-seed oil flask from dock 2, walk 180 m to the inspection room, hold it to a 400 mm wall mirror so the etched lot code reflects onto card M-4, then take the flask to forge bay F-2 and press a wax seal into a 12 mm die at 62 C. A clerk matches the reflected lot code, checks flask mass within 4 g of 310 g, and measures die depth at 1.8-2.2 mm. The 1,480 fee is paid either way. A blurred reflection, a cracked flask, or clocks off over 35s voids the slot for 8 shifts.
